Templates get the animation toolbox: tween, loop, glyphs, on a host-handed timeline (rich-animation-42lg.zck) (#493)

* Templates get the animation toolbox: tween, loop, glyphs, on a host-handed timeline (rich-animation-42lg.zck)

animationFuncs(frameTime, options) now draws every function on a Timeline
the host hands in as a getter (the host's own clock when omitted), so a
daemon pauses, reverses or scrubs a session's animations with nothing
recompiled, and a frame's stamp is carried back onto the host's clock by
Timeline.run rather than left on the mapped one. One helper reads the time,
the timeline and reduced motion for every function.

New functions, each an exact arity of typed slots:
- tween <seconds> <ease> <start> <from> <to>: a number, ease by name
- loop <seconds> <start>: the way through a period, 0 to 1
- glyphs <name> <start> <fragment>: a catalogue glyph effect on a fragment

A colour tween and a ramp scroll are a tween and a loop read through ramp,
not new functions: ColorRamp is the one blender. glyphs runs on the
unrendered RichText (reglyphText), sharing Reglyphed's walk and contract
checks. options also carries asciiOnly, for the glyphs an effect picks.

Docs: template-bindings "Animating a template"; pointers from animation.md.
Demo: §6 Motion in rich-template-bindings, motion and reduced side by side.

* Template animation docs say which hosts redraw a moving number, and on which clock a start is (rich-animation-42lg.zck review)

An App does not poll a silent function view, so a template's tween or loop
moves there only while animate() is held; the docs and module header claimed
every host redraws on time. A start is on the handed-in timeline's clock.
reglyphText's checks see the text's own glyphs only. Demo comment lists the
whole toolbox.
